scope: Local preset addition, read-only parameter inspection, and existing approximate phone preview support

adding.entry: 预设 → 我的预设 → 添加本地预设
adding.fileNames: Case-insensitive .np3 and .ncp; extensionless provider names are inferred from a validated binary container
adding.source: Original bytes retained with SHA-256 identity; duplicate content preserves prior metadata

inspection.entry: 预设详情 → 查看 NP3 参数
inspection.snapshot: Immutable groups, rows and values; source is bounded and defensively copied
inspection.numericGate: Publish interpreted values only after the existing strict PresetPreviewProfiles parser accepts the whole recipe
fields: 锐化、中范围锐化、清晰度
对比度、高光、阴影、白色色阶、黑色色阶、饱和度
自定义曲线状态与已验证的 257 个采样点
红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫、洋红的色相/饱和/亮度
高光、中间调、阴影的色相/浓度/亮度
受支持单色的滤镜和调色状态
inspection.unsupported: Keep only validated container metadata and the exact unsupported reason; do not invent numerical results or camera compatibility
inspection.curveRule: When a custom curve is active, do not present inactive basic-tone sentinels as -127 adjustments

interface.close: Small top-right close icon; 32dp visible circle within a 44dp target; no separate footer action
interface.palette: Reuse current light/dark UiPalette and AppDialog finish

validation.realCorpus: Local 142-recipe and full original ZIP archives absent; those corpus runs skipped and no recipes downloaded
validation.native: Final installed-APK-bound native evidence is recorded separately in docs/validation/np3-inspection160

unchanged: Existing phone-renderer math and strict subset acceptance
iOS project and its build workflow
remaining: Unverified NP3 versions or active parameter combinations are explicitly unsupported
NP3 parsing on iOS is not part of this Android change
No new NP3 camera-write capability or Nikon color-equivalence claim
